items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Aime and I were great, great friends, when I first met him in 1935

ctx.x: to live?" We said, "Yes, we do." And he said, "Well, stay undercover," he said, "Go in the streets only when you have to." And that's what I did until Japan -- But before then, something had happened. I showed you a picture yesterday of Aime Barelli.
